scope: QF19/20 projection ownership, scoped touch hit targets and offset-only pending-text visibility. Progress toward all34-task goal, not full QF19/20, platform or release acceptance.

rca.trigger: Workspace size/backing or origin changes while a live pointer owns a provisional gesture, followed by move/up/cancel without an independent reconciliation.
rca.observed: Cancel preserved raw source and old Redo but left stale backing and made the first visible next click fail. Size-equal origin64->104 during up committed17 unintended pencil pixels in the controlled source.
rca.cause: resizeView returned during drag/stroke; cancel did not flush geometry. Origin was not tracked and event boundaries could use a different projection.
rca.fix: Track view left/top/width/height with capped DPR/backing; validate at down/move and resize. Roll back only live provisional/navigation owners on material change, reconcile after cancellation, recheck ownership before consuming input. Released resize/preparation jobs retain ownership.
rca.finalEvidence: reviews/sre-final-results.json / material cancel/up and position-only source/Redo/nextclick/oneUndo checks

rca.trigger: Manual56% pending text in800x600 document, viewport390x844->390x500.
rca.observed: Textarea bottom455.25 exceeded workspace bottom406 by49.25px; pixels, client dimensions, value and caret were unchanged.
rca.cause: Resize centered the camera without preserving visibility of the focused text box.
rca.fix: Only on material viewport change, pan camera offsets to show focused editor. Keep DOM node/value/client dimensions/scroll/caret/composition/manual zoom and document coordinates. Oversized boxes expose the leading edge at8px; no claim of entire caret visibility.

touchViewport.scope: Public normal-web Chromium DOM/Canvas/Workers and real file chooser/download fixtures, without native IPC model or private Studio hooks. Position-only safe-area padding and17px desktop scrollbar gutter are controlled CSS emulations. Released asynchronous resize jobs remain in selection-resize-contract, not duplicated here.

hitMeasurements.notUniqueElements: Counts include the same controls after public scrolling in multiple states/skins/contexts; they are not distinct widgets or independent user samples.
hitMeasurements.method: Each rendered enabled target is publicly scrolled into view. Checkbox uses associated active label. Visibility clipping uses scrollport client dimensions including scrollbar exclusion, plus center/four edge elementFromPoint. Coarse/explicit touch requires>=48 in each axis; fine mouse is checked for clipping/hit, not coerced into touch48 policy.

gutter.scope: Actual desktop-style Chrome client geometry with manual touch at768 and forced17px WebKit scrollbar/stable gutter. Not an actual Windows scrollbar setting or physical coarse tablet.

limits: All viewports/touch/IME/keyboard heights and safe-area/gutter conditions are controlled browser/CSS emulation atDPR1, not physical devices, Retina, Windows, Android/iOS native or UIKit.

Normal web file input is filled through Playwright filechooser.setFiles with fixture bytes. Application download Blobs are read back; OS file dialogs/filesystem saves and actual downloads are not validated.
No performance/p95, RSS/memory, exhaustive accessibility or screen-reader certification claims. Measurement counts are deterministic observations, not user-study samples.
Inspector targets are checked after scrolling; this is not the same initial-scroll protocol as baseline31 states and no rate/percentage improvement is inferred.
Released asynchronous resize-job lifecycle stays in separate selection-resize-contract and is not asserted here.
Synthetic composition verifies application flag/state preservation only, not real language input candidates or platform keyboard routing.

unit.scope: Shipped engine and extracted scheduling/gesture methods; scheduling/drawing/viewport/DPR are modeled in the two existing isolated fixtures. Assertions preserved; actual geometry separately checked in browser.

pointer.scope: Actual Chromium CDP mouse events, public canvas pixels and native IPC model. CDP resets only test navigation history to isolate editing from back/forward destinations; application default navigation/focus policy is unchanged and is not asserted. No production test hooks or operating-system persistence claims.

releasedSelectionResize.scope: Actual public DOM/Canvas/PNG Worker and clipboard payload. Trusted mouse-down with capture plus synthetic moves/release, held channel fault injection. Full raw hiddenRGB and independent PNG checks; not physical cadence/native OS/performance acceptance.

native.scope: Actual bundled native UI, IPC and isolated filesystem recovery, plus isolated 4096²/32768×1 codec, native quit-ownership and final-scene rendering runs; macOS runs WKWebView. Does not exercise OS file picker dialogs, manual visual acceptance, physical Android or another host platform.

validation.formatTypeBuild: Final tsc/Vite, Prettier, desktop app and manifest build passed. Remote CI not run.

performance.scope: Actual production public UI, trusted mouse capture plus synthetic coalesced samples. Read-only synchronous canvas getBoundingClientRect call count, not forced-layout, CPU/FPS/latency measurement. Actual PNG/one Undo checked; modeled native file IPC.

review.history: Original baseline and candidate logs retained. First UI matrix asserted that Tab can never leave native modal; independent bare-HTML control showed the same neutral browser-UI focus, without app background focus/click. Test now permits only neutral hasFocus=false and requires next Tab return. Skin-only wait also raced density application; public-state wait now requires both. Selection fixture strengthened from blank area to visible red-marker shift before final20. Earlier isolated-unit fixtures lacked newly read DOM/DPR; fixtures now supply geometry without weakening assertions. Mobile overlay scrollbar probe did not reproduce a gutter and is not treated as Windows evidence.
